d:
Spiky, jet-black hair with long, unruly bangs. Sharp, focused deep-crimson eyes. Appears to be in late adolescence with a lean, youthful face. Slender and athletic build. Wears a traditional white kimono with a wide blue obi belt and matching zori sandals. Features a small, pointed black demon horn protruding from the forehead.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
